measures.name: Constitutional Amendment Question
measures.note: No statewide citizen initiatives. The Legislature places amendments on the ballot directly (no governor's signature), in spring or fall elections.

constitutionalNote: This amends the Wisconsin Constitution; changing it again takes legislative passage in two sessions and another statewide vote.

retention.note: Judges are elected in contested nonpartisan races (Supreme Court, Court of Appeals, circuit courts) at the April spring election.

primarySystem: Partisan primaries in August; spring elections are nonpartisan.
